fact: In an extension request received 12 August 2025 Seychelles told the WTO its Single Window is not yet in service (definitive date 30 June 2027) and that an 18-month ASYCUDA World upgrade to 4.4 began in early 2025 after the EDF project (Sept 2021 to May 2024) added express courier, manifest, e-payment and excise bonded warehouse modules.
title: Seychelles - Article 10.4 Single window (Technical assistance projects)
